mira: Hey team — ran the FP8 kernel canary on 7/LLama-2-75B (AWQ) across H100 and L40S. Seeing consistent token-level BLEU/QA hit on long-prefix prompts (>2k tokens) on H100 only. Anyone else?

arjun: Which metric and magnitude?

mira: QA exact-match dropped ~2.4% absolute on H100 FP8 kernel vs baseline FP16. L40S FP8 is +0.1% (noise).

sylvia: That delta is large. Are you sure it's kernel-only and not batch/tiling or KV warmup?

mira: Good call. I replayed shadow traffic with same batching. Repro steps below.

mira: ```
# repro (local canary)
curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/models/llama-75b/generate \
  -d '{"prompt":"<long prefix>...","max_tokens":512,"mode":"stream"}' \
  -H "X-Model-Variant: fp8-kernel-h100"
```

mira: Expected: parity with fp16 baseline. Observed: token skew start around token 40, grows by token 200.

samir: Any NaNs or infs in logs? memory contention?

mira: No NaNs. Logs show KV-cache allocations and an increase in soft-fallbacks to reference path at runtime.

jen: Can you paste the small trace from the runtime logs?

mira: ```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] kernel_fp8_forward: tiling=128 stride=32
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] kv_warmup: prefix_len=2048 used=0.93
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] quant_fallback: activation_saturation=0.87 -> engaged reference_path
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] output_token_40: token_id_diff=true
```

arjun: activation_saturation ~0.87 is suspicious. We saw similar saturation-induced drift in earlier FP8 runs when residual scale leaked. Could be per-channel scale mismatch between compilation kernels (H100) and runtime quantization shim.

sylvia: Is the AWQ per-tensor scale computed on-the-fly different between devices? AWQ/GPTQ packaging can rely on float32 accum for some ops; if the H100 FP8 kernel uses FP8 accum path, quant rounding differs.

mira: Exactly. H100 kernel we enabled uses an FP8 accumulation path for matmuls; L40S kernel still uses fp32 accum (fallback/compat) for the same microcode. So the numerical path diverges.

samir: What about retraining the scale table with the H100 kernel emulation? i.e., run per-channel calibration on the kernel's reference path then ship scales.

mira: I tried per-channel recalibration with 10k samples — improved by ~1.3% but still ~1.1% delta remains.

jen: Could be order-of-ops sensitivity — layernorm placement + leftover fp16 bias. Any differences in residual injection order in the kernel?

arjun: Also check the compiler flags: autotune can swap GEMM tiling order which slightly changes rounding. If H100 uses vectorized wider accumulators in FP8 path, tie-breaking differs.

mira: Action items I propose:
- revert canary on H100 to fp16 for now (minimize customer exposure)
- add instrumentation to capture per-layer activation histograms and activation_saturation metric in prod canary
- run a focused bakeoff: AWQ vs GPTQ vs INT8 with the H100 FP8 kernel, same calibration protocol
- evaluate small retrain on calibration set (per-channel) and two-pass scaling hack

samir: Agree. Also add a synthetic long-prefix test (2k-8k tokens) to our nightly perf/quality suite.

sylvia: Can we gate FP8 kernel by a routing policy that considers prefix length and model family? e.g., FP8 only if prefix < 512 or model is <30B.

mira: Good idea. I'd prefer routing policy + auto-fallback threshold for activation_saturation > 0.8.

canary-bot: Canary alert: 3/8 canary runs on H100 FP8 exceeded activation_saturation threshold. Rolling back variant to fp16 on 2 nodes. :warning:

deploy-bot: Rollback executed: variant=fp16, nodes=2, time=2026-03-20T14:18:09Z

jen: For the bakeoff, let's capture both token-level KL and downstream accuracy (EM/F1) on the eval suite. Token-level divergence can be subtle but accumulates.

arjun: Also include latency/throughput vs cost delta — FP8 kernel buys us ~25% throughput on H100 in microbenchmarks. We need to know tradeoff: 25% perf vs ~1-2% quality loss at longprefix.

mira: I'll create the bakeoff matrix and upload artifacts. Preliminary plan:
- datasets: longprefix-docs (1k examples), QA-eval, summarization-psuedo-long
- quant methods: AWQ (per-channel), GPTQ (fused), static INT8 (calib), FP8-kernel-compiled
- devices: H100 (fp8 kernel vs fp16), L40S (fp8 vs fp16)
- metrics: EM, F1, ROUGE-L, token-KL, activation_saturation, fallback-counts, latency

samir: Ping me when you have the matrix. I can run distributed jobs on the canary pool.

mira: Will do. For now, H100 FP8 kernel remains rolled back from canary. I'll post updates in this thread with bakeoff CSVs. :slightly_smiling_face:
